title: Talking to NPCs and chatting, without the scrolling
summary: A Talk link opens that NPC's conversation first, and Campaign → Chat now fills the screen.
items: Opening an NPC from Here, a place card or the Market shows that conversation first and moves focus to it; everyone else at the location folds into "Other people here".
One Find an NPC picker searches names, places and descriptions (it replaces the separate record search).
An NPC with nothing to sell no longer shows an empty Inventory heading.
Campaign → Chat shows the conversation directly: a full-height history, the message box above the bottom navigation, and Jump to latest after you scroll up.
Connection & recovery, device backups and manual sharing now appear only on the Room tab.
